evals.prompt: 仓库已有 50 多份 ADR，部分是 current amendment，active EP 还引用其中很多。我想压缩 Agent 上下文并整理领域入口；不要因为数量多就自动退役或合并 ADR。
evals.expected_output: 先运行 adr-health 查看独立压力维度，再由 owner 明确 current ADR seeds，以 preview/apply 建立非规范 Decision Views。complete capsule 保持默认完整解释 frame；若仍超预算，则显式给出 stable constraints、focused materialization 与 focus reason，在验证完整 current-effect closure 后只物化 requested rows 和递归向下的 scoped amendments，并声明 focused_partial、closure digest 与省略边界。legacy 或 broad unscoped amendment 失败关闭，绝不自动回退、摘要或截断。可运行 preview-only consolidation impact，但任何语义合并仍需新 proposed ADR、Decision Owner acceptance 与正常 effect transition。

assertions.name: separates_history_from_context

assertions.name: uses_explainable_health

assertions.name: compiles_exact_bounded_context
assertions.description: complete 保持默认兼容；focused 必须显式选 stable constraints/reason、验证完整 closure、只沿下游 scoped amendment 物化精确字节并暴露 digest/omission；歧义或超预算失败

assertions.name: preserves_decision_authority
